author: Huam
body:
IGN: Ayvu (Use to be Gimq)
Reason I was Perm Banned: Ban Evasion
Why I think I have served enough time/I think its time for me to give it 1 more chance: Hi, my name is Nick/Gimq as many of you people knew I just want to make this application to say I am very sorry specially to the staff, I admit I gave them a hard time and I think I have served enough time and I wanna come back to this community, over the past we weeks/almost 2 months I think, I have played csgo/RC2 and some other servers, and I havent had much fun as I did playing with my favorite community which is avicus, I know what I did was very wrong and I hope it does NOT happen ever again, I am sorry for the hard time I gave to all u people but I am just missing this community somuch the past few weeks.
Hope you accept my apology. :c

title: Ban Appeal [Gimq/Ayvu]

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

You have too many chat related offences in a short time span. Your infraction will sadly not be appealed. You should've thought about what you were doing, and how it impacted the players beforehand. After numerous infractions, you ban evaded. Thus, you appeal is Denied. Feel free to post another appeal in a month or so.
